interpretation_limits: Pad-to-silkscreen (capability table) and silkscreen-to-solder-mask clearance (silkscreen guide) are distinct limits with distinct sources; neither is derived from the other.

KiCad 10 silk_clearance against a pad reports silk_over_copper measured from pad copper; the actual distance does not change with the pad solder-mask margin (host probe, 2026-10-22). It grades pad-to-silk only. Silkscreen-to-solder-mask has no qualified measurement and stays unknown.

The capability table names 1.0 mm as minimum text height; the guide names 0.8 mm as absolute minimum and 1.0 mm as recommended. The profile grades the capability 1.0 mm minimum; the 0.8 mm guide value is a sourced advisory that never grades.
Recommendations (0.2 mm line width, 0.25 mm silkscreen-to-mask) are advisories only: no native rule, predicate, defect or extra charge.

Text height and thickness are graded for KiCad stroke-font silk text by native text_height/text_thickness; KiCad stroke-font nominal height equals the centreline cap height (printed extent adds the stroke). Outline-font or knockout text, and other unqualified silk items, leave silk limits unknown.
No silkscreen-to-silkscreen limit was found in either source; none is recorded.

Applicability is bound per source page: each graded silk limit needs the base-material scope recorded on its own page, and the saved board stackup must name only dielectric materials qualified to a supplier name in that scope (KiCad FR4 as FR-4). A board without a saved stackup material, with another material, or outside the scope leaves the limit unknown. Order-form options, pricing, assembly and supplier approval are not claimed.

Each limit and advisory quote must be one whole recorded fact line whose subject matches the key and whose role matches its use: limits cite a minimum or absolute minimum, recommended advisories cite a recommendation. A recommendation cited as a limit is unknown.
Source verification proves occurrence in the original numeric record, not authenticity or interpretation of vendor bytes. Raw response hashes cannot replay absent vendor pages.
recording_method: Worker reviewed the host HTML Legend table and the silkscreen guide table and recorded numbers/names only; no vendor prose, graphics, designs or code retained.
